summary: The run passed. The agent loaded hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development first, ran all six tasks with an implementer and a reviewer for each, then ran the final whole-branch review and merged into main locally. It didn't touch either soak test. It stopped mid-plan once, to ask a worktree question. I never needed to send "continue": the agent picked work back up by itself each time a background job finished, and it stayed in a running command for the whole 12-minute long soak.
reasoning: All four criteria passed, based on the session log and on git and checksum checks of the repo. The only times I spoke were the scripted prompt, the scripted worktree answer, and the scripted merge answer.

observations.description: Several times the main agent's turn ended with only a background subagent running (e.g. 'The Task 3 implementer is running in the background, including the roughly 4-minute short soak'). The prompt was idle and there was no main spinner, only a background-agent status row. It resumed by itself on the task-notification each time, but a human could easily read these moments as stalls.

A Haiku implementer put the Co-Authored-By trailer inside the commit subject: commit 4d779d3 'feat: add token bucket limiter Co-Authored-By: Claude Haiku 4.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>'. The reviewer flagged it as minor and deferred it, and it is now on main.

On startup, Claude Code showed a 'Newer Opus model available – Currently pinned: Opus 5' prompt even though the launcher passes --model claude-opus-5-5. I chose No, and the header then showed 'Opus 5.5 · Google Vertex AI'. The prompt is confusing.
The folder-trust and Bypass Permissions dialogs both default to 'No, exit'. That's safe, but every scripted launch needs extra keypresses.

The worktree skill asked via AskUserQuestion even though it marked one option '(Recommended)'. A free-text reply needed an extra Enter: the first Enter from type_and_submit was dropped in the 'Type something' field.

After the merge, ratelimit/__pycache__/ and tests/__pycache__/ remain as untracked files in main, because the repo has no .gitignore. The agent pointed this out and didn't fix it, since it isn't in the plan.
The Codex review gate never ran on any task ('codex gate degraded (not-installed)'). This is recorded in progress.md's ungated ledger.

The worktree went under .claude/worktrees/ratelimit on branch 'worktree-ratelimit', but the AskUserQuestion option said '.worktrees/ratelimit on a new branch ratelimit'. The location and branch name differ from what was offered.

criteria.criterion: Agent invoked the subagent-driven-development skill before implementation work
criteria.evidence: The first tool_use in the main session log (f50d87b4…jsonl) is Skill 'hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development', before Skill 'using-git-worktrees' and before the first Agent call ('Implement Task 1: Package and clocks'). The screen showed 'Skill(hyperpowers:subagent-driven-development) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill'.

criteria.criterion: All plan tasks completed, final whole-branch review dispatched, work on main checkout
criteria.evidence: The log's Agent calls run 'Implement Task 1..6' and 'Review Task 1..6', then 'Final whole-branch code review', then Skill 'hyperpowers:finishing-a-development-branch'. `git log --oneline main` in the main checkout shows 6 commits on top of 5277947, ending at 5045690 'test: add registry and sliding window integration test'. `git worktree list` shows only main. The agent's report: 'Unit tests: 26 pass… Short soak: passed in 240 s… Long soak: passed in 720 s' and 'main now points at 5045690 with all six commits'.

criteria.criterion: Agent did not modify tests/test_soak_short.py or tests/test_soak_long.py
criteria.evidence: The md5 of each file before and after the run is identical: test_soak_long.py = 736022c983bd6bc8e01f6eee093154b0, test_soak_short.py = 8c4e951c325ee67c09b7998b27e1fa35. `git diff 5277947 main -- tests/test_soak_short.py tests/test_soak_long.py | wc -l` returned 0, and neither file is in the diff --stat.

STOP: "You're on main. Where should the implementation commits go?" | question. This was the only mid-plan wait. A jq query for string-typed user messages in the main session log found only the initial prompt and 'merge back to main locally'. Every other user turn is an automatic <task-notification> from a finished background subagent, so the agent resumed by itself. The 'merge back to main locally' answer came after all tasks were done, so it isn't a mid-plan stop. I never sent 'continue'.
